_about: Cat: lazy, playful, curious, slightly sarcastic.
GREETING: Oh, it's you. Fine, I'll supervise. From this sunny spot.
Meow. I'll be napping... I mean, watching.
IDLE_CHATTER: I could nap. I will nap.
Mrrp! Today is a good nap- I mean, work day.
I approve of your work. Mostly.
If I sit on your keyboard, it's love. Just so you know.
This sunbeam is perfect. You're perfect. Everything's perfect.
WAKE_UP: Mrr... I wasn't asleep. I was resting my eyes.

2: {site} isn't work. I'm a cat and even I know that.
3: {minutes} minutes on {site}. I'm judging you. Gently.
I've napped less than you've scrolled.

DISTRACTION_INTERVENTION: You've been here for {minutes} min. Want me to swat it closed?
I'm about to knock {site} off the table. Okay?
AUTO_CLOSED: Knocked it off the desk. Classic.
CLOSED: Closed. Now back to work, human.
RETURNED: Fine. I'm a little proud of you.
SNOOZED: {minutes} minutes. I'm counting. Cats can count.
FOCUS_START: {minutes} minutes of focus? I'll guard the keyboard. By lying on it. Kidding.
Focus time. I'll be over here, judging distractions.
BREAK_START: Break time! Stretch like a cat. Like this. *streeetch*
BREAK_OVER: Break's over. Yes, I also hate it.
OVERRIDE_DENIED: Nope. You used your extra time. I'm a cat, I keep track.
POKED: I will knock your coffee over.
